items.stem: In LEED, what is the difference between a prerequisite and a credit?

options.text: Prerequisites are mandatory with no points; credits are optional and earn points
options.rationale: Correct: prerequisites must be met to certify but award no points, while credits are optional and contribute points.

options.text: Prerequisites earn the most points; credits earn none
options.rationale: Prerequisites award no points; this is reversed.
They differ: one is mandatory, the other optional.
